rows.text: A small wooden box sat on the table.
Her brother Leo watched from the door.
Its lid was firmly closed.
A brass latch held it fast.
A flag at the window hung limp.
Mara longed to open the box.
She gave the lid a hard push, but it would not move.

rows.text: She wondered what the latch did.
She shoved the latch, and it slid free.
She was delighted with the latch.
She pushed the lid hard, and it popped open.
A toy flew out and landed on the floor.
A spring inside the box uncoiled.
Mara realized that the latch had kept the lid shut.
She marveled at the toy.
She laughed with joy.
She wondered what the flag did.
She gave the flag a hard push, and it swung and hung still again.
